rows.title: California Paid Family Leave
rows.condition: worked in California and paid into State Disability Insurance; up to 8 weeks of paid leave in a 12-month period

rows.title: Dependent Care FSA: check with your job
rows.condition: ask your employer whether it offers a Dependent Care FSA (a work account for childcare costs); nothing is checked for you

rows.title: Federal Child Tax Credit
rows.condition: claimed on the yearly tax return

rows.title: Add your baby to health insurance
rows.condition: birth is a qualifying life event

rows.title: Massachusetts Child and Family Tax Credit
rows.condition: Massachusetts resident filing a state tax return; $440 per eligible individual for tax year 2024 and later

rows.title: Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave
rows.condition: worked in Massachusetts and paid into the leave program; up to 12 weeks to bond with a child, finished before the child's first birthday

rows.title: New York Paid Family Leave
rows.condition: worked in New York and covered by Paid Family Leave; up to 12 weeks of job-protected leave in 2026
